comments.author: JohnHighborn
comments.body_html:
Hi, im from the UK so if you have provided a imgur link to configer mod, sorry I can not see it, even with a VPN.

My question is how do I configure the mod to increase the amount of Strength and Endurance. There are 4 sliders, do I lower values or increase them?

thanks

comments.author: Oriontacocat
comments.body_html:
The imgur link is just install instructions.

So, for the configuration, I have it set up so that the leveling speed scales with your encumbrance, when you are just over the encumbrance threshold, it’ll use the “Start” value, and when you’re near the point where you don’t gain stamina while sprinting, it uses the “End” value, between those points it does a linear interpolation between the two.
